card.name: Word 'at' before contact phone numbers
card.fires_on: The word 'at' right after a named person or company in a 'contact X at' line, just before an email or phone number. Also fires on digits inside phone numbers in contact lines.

modes.label: 'at' in contact lines
modes.description: The word 'at' after a contact name, leading into an email address or phone number.

modes.label: Digits in phone numbers
modes.description: Digits inside a telephone number given for contact information.

card.plain: It lights up on the word 'at' in lines that say who to contact and give a phone number or email next.
